title: Engineering Innovation Summit 2025
excerpt: A look at the keynote sessions, design challenges, and takeaways from a national engineering leadership event.
content: At the Engineering Innovation Summit, our team attended sessions on sustainable design, startup strategy, and student leadership in engineering communities.
One of the most valuable takeaways was the emphasis on collaboration across disciplines, especially when solving real-world problems under time pressure.
We also learned how to better communicate research ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences, which helped shape how we present capstone work and outreach initiatives.

title: Atlantic Student Engineering Forum
excerpt: Highlights from poster sessions, networking events, and the practical lessons shared by student presenters.
content: The forum gave students an opportunity to present their work, receive feedback from peers, and connect with professionals in the Atlantic region.
Sessions focused on project management, innovation in manufacturing, and emerging tools for engineering education and design.
The strongest lesson was that a well-explained project story can be just as important as the technical result itself.

title: Design Competition Networking Weekend
excerpt: A weekend of design challenges, mentorship, and lessons on how to prepare for future competitions.
content: This conference experience focused on hands-on competition preparation, including judging expectations, presentation structure, and team coordination.
Students learned that early preparation, clear division of roles, and mock presentations make a major difference when competing under pressure.
It also highlighted the value of seeking mentorship from experienced teams and using feedback to improve future submissions.
